spanish: Y en el mes el primero, en catorce día al mes, Pésaj a Jehová.

findings.issue: פֶּסַח is a common noun (Ncmsa), not a proper name; Pésaj leaves that lemma untranslated and capitalizes it as a title.

notes: The date clause matches the tokens, including singular día and a Jehová for לַיהוָה.
